## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-03

A ground-up redesign of the crate: `Copy` styles with zero-allocation
rendering, multi-segment composition, terminal decorations, adaptive colors
and an ANSI-aware text toolkit. `Console` is kept as a deprecated alias of
`Span`, so most 1.x user code continues to compile. See the README migration
notes for the (few) intentional breaking changes.

### Features
- **perf:** `Style` is now `Copy` and `const`-constructible; attributes are a
  `u16` `Effects` bitset (no heap allocation, idempotent adds, canonical
  emission order)
- **perf:** allocation-free `Display` — SGR codes are written straight into
  the destination formatter; SGR digit emission without `format!`
- **perf:** environment detection is cached and invalidated by
  `set_color_choice`
- **api:** `Span` replaces `Console` (kept as an alias) and adds OSC 8
  hyperlinks (`link`), conditional styling (`when`), `fg_hex`/`bg_hex` and
  whole-style replacement
- **api:** `Line` composes differently-styled spans into one row with
  last-span styling and visible-width alignment
- **api:** decorations — `gradient`, `gradient_bg`, `rainbow`, `rainbow_bg`,
  `Panel` boxes with inlaid titles
- **api:** adaptive colors — `ColorLevel` detection (`supports_color_level`,
  honors `FORCE_COLOR=1/2/3`, `COLORTERM`, `TERM`), `Color::to_256`,
  `Color::to_16`, `Color::degrade_to`, `Span::render_with`,
  `Line::render_with`
- **api:** color intelligence — hex-string parsing (`Color::from_hex_str`,
  `FromStr`), `Color::luminance`, `Color::readable_on`, `Color::lerp`,
  `palette_rgb`
- **api:** ANSI-aware text toolkit — `char_width`, `visible_width`,
  `truncate` (ellipsis + style-safe resets), `pad`, `Align`
- **api:** macros — `paint!`, `style!`, `line!`
- **api:** IO — `eprint`, `eprintln` and fallible `try_print*`/`try_eprint*`
  variants for stdout and stderr

### Breaking Changes
- Attribute SGR codes are emitted in canonical order and deduplicated;
  exact-output tests may need updating
- `Style::attributes()` returns an `Effects` bitset instead of `&[Attribute]`
- The `insta` dev-dependency was replaced by exact-string contract tests

### Documentation
- Rewrite README with feature matrix, measured benchmarks and a 1.x
  migration guide; add `docs/DESIGN.md` describing the v2 audit and decisions
- New examples: `showcase` (feature tour) and `bench` (comparative
  micro-benchmark vs owo-colors, yansi and colored)

### Continuous Integration
- Lint policy moved into `Cargo.toml` (pedantic denied, cast lints relaxed
  with rationale); workflows keep fmt + clippy + tests (both feature sets) +
  docs + MSRV + coverage
